rationale: Manual seven-day local synthetic-data renewal explicitly requested by the project owner on 24 November 2026 after expiry. The prior approval dates are retained in renewal_history; this is a new review, not automatic renewal or a widening of the seven-day gate. A read-only, network-isolated runtime probe and public source hashes confirm the exact previously accepted image/package/application scope. SQLite 3.53.4 remains vulnerable: FTS5 and session are compiled in, but the unchanged app exposes no FTS/MATCH, changeset processing, arbitrary SQL or database uploads. Upstream SQLite 3.54.0 fixes these CVEs and Alpine edge offers 3.54.1; do not mix edge into the stable runtime. Prepare and verify a compatible patched local image before expiry. No AWS or production authorization.
conditions: Local synthetic-data project only; no AWS/production release authorization
Keep non-root, read-only root filesystem, dropped capabilities and no-new-privileges
No database uploads, arbitrary SQL, FTS tables, changeset processing or untrusted database imports
Any application code/schema, base, Dockerfile, runtime lock or SQLite package change invalidates acceptance
Recheck vendor fixes before expiry; fail closed at expiry; no automatic renewal
